**Important note on scope:** Conagra's fiscal Q3 2026 (period ended February 22, 2026) had *not* yet been reported by March 31, 2026 — it was released on April 1, 2026, just after the cutoff. So the last four quarters actually reported as of March 31, 2026 are Q3 FY25 through Q2 FY26.
